rule: Two-step encounter. Walk gates (wall-clock throttle, per-axis distance from the last encounter point, not in a town). Per-subtile frequency by day part, rolled 0-100; an encounter is a candidate when the roll is below the frequency. Weighted pick among rows whose condition holds and whose counter is not zero (luck offsets the draw). Telegraph: a 7-frame map icon blink (special rows use a second icon pair). Detection: survival-skill roll (capped 95, plus a scanner and a per-tile modifier); spotted gives a yes/no prompt and XP of 100 minus the skill, unspotted drops straight into the scene. Groups: count min..max with easy/hard and party-size offsets; ratio mode; placement by formation (ring at perception-based distance with scatter; line, double line, wedge, cone, huddle walks) with retries and a drift cap. Two sub-groups start a combat between their first members.
